answer: Behaviour-fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fake identities. An applicant locks 60 credits for 20 epochs and proves a fingerprint of tasks, counterparties and timing, split like light through a prism. A marble ledger records each fingerprint once, so a repeat is flagged, and a plume of copied traces fails when timing contradicts history. Forging 1000 identities costs 60000 credits locked, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
